mumu_adb_description: Maa native Android capture and touch. Requires Limbus already in the foreground; does not launch the game.
description: Native Windows Limbus automation with MaaFramework
windows_window_description: MaaEnd-style background capture, cursor-position window mouse messages and PostMessage keys. Verify the expected next page after input.
windows_background_description: Window-position mouse messages and PostMessage keys. Test whether this game accepts background input.
windows_front_description: Screen capture and foreground mouse/keyboard input. Keep the game visible.
global_build_description: How this team is used in the Mirror Dungeon: which gifts it goes for and who deploys first. It is TEAMS #N in the game. Both settings default to "keep", so leave them alone unless you want a change; a change is checked and saved before the next Mirror task starts, and the team of a run in progress can be changed once that run ends.
mirror_team_systems_description: Which systems' E.G.O gifts this team goes for in the Mirror Dungeon: the shop, floor gifts and the starting gift all follow it.
mirror_team_keywords_description: Tick one, several or all of them. With none ticked the team is not tied to a system and the program chooses freely by its scoring.
mirror_team_order_description: Who deploys first. "Follow the game" is recommended: arrange the order on the game's own team screen and the program uses it as it is; the order it read is written to the log and recorded with its screenshot, so you can check it.
mirror_team_order_game: Follow the order set in the game
mirror_team_order_text_description: Write the sinners in deployment order by number or name, separated by spaces, for example 6 8 7 3 5; the ones you do not name follow in roster order. Numbers: 1 Yi Sang, 2 Faust, 3 Don Quixote, 4 Ryoshu, 5 Meursault, 6 Hong Lu, 7 Heathcliff, 8 Ishmael, 9 Rodion, 10 Sinclair, 11 Outis, 12 Gregor.
main_open_game_description: Launch Android through Maa and verify the foreground; leave an already open game running; when the game does not come to the front, close it and start it once more. Connect the game window first on Windows.
main_mirror_description: Use global saved builds and deployment order. Choose one team or a rotation here. Hard by default; spending requires a configured budget.
main_experience_description: Uses a saved team and navigates through Drive to Luxcavation. An unfinished Mirror run blocks navigation. Stage selection, farming and cost verification are not yet supported.
main_thread_description: Uses a saved team and navigates through Drive to Luxcavation. An unfinished Mirror run blocks navigation. Stage selection, farming and cost verification are not yet supported.
main_rewards_description: Claim rewards for the current cleared Mirror run with its module budget. Mail and daily mission collection are not yet supported.
mirror_star_description: Lix zero-based 0–9: left to right, upper row then lower. Base graces only, no Enhance or remaining-star conversion. Auto mode takes an affordable subset of the saved build plan (task choices if absent), with current visible prices and the per-run budget. Unknown prices or pending transactions stop.
mirror_initial_keyword_description: Selects the initial gift group. Floor gifts still use the saved build systems and preferences.
mirror_run_bounds_description: Bounded steps per launch, not dungeon runs. Reaching the limit preserves state and stops.
mirror_run_count_description: How many complete Mirror Dungeon runs after this one? A run counts only after five cleared floors, a claimed payout and a return to the lobby; 0 means no number named and the window walks to another bound.
mirror_shop_fusion_description: Before leaving a shop, open "Fuse Gifts" once: a recipe the game itself lists under "Fusion Available" (all gifts owned, fixed result) is fused. Only a recipe whose forecast reads 100% is fused; Wishmaking is never ticked (no Starlight is spent) and no random fusion is made. Fusing costs no coins.
mirror_reward_claim_description: Whether the rewards are claimed and the lobby reached after five floors are cleared. A run's rewards cost 5 modules; with weekly bonuses switched on in the game it is 6 or 18. The program never changes that switch and never clicks "Give Up Rewards". When the offer cannot be read it stops on the reward page and clicks nothing.
mirror_reward_claim_off: Do not claim (stop on the reward page)
mirror_reward_claim_lost: A run that ended before the dungeon was cleared (lost)
mirror_reward_claim_lost_description: When a run ends before all five floors are cleared, its rewards are smaller but cost the same 5 modules. With "Do not claim" the program stops on the reward page and presses nothing; the game will not start another run until this one is dealt with. The program never presses "Give Up Rewards". A lost run is not claimed while weekly bonuses are switched on. A claimed lost run is not counted as a completed run and the team does not rotate.
mirror_reward_claim_lost_off: Do not claim (stop on the reward page)
mirror_schedule_description: For running on a timer: the Mirror Dungeon is played only on the chosen days, and once the day's runs are done another start ends at once without touching the game. Booked per game-server day (by default the day turns at 06:00 Korea time). "No schedule" plays on every start.
mirror_runs_per_day_description: Complete runs to finish on a chosen day. A run counts once five floors are cleared, the reward is claimed and the lobby is reached.
mirror_preferences_description: Edits add or remove only the selected preferences when the Mirror task starts. Systems, order and other entries are preserved. Active-build changes stop; blocks win.
mirror_battle_assignment_description: Choose the proven game auto-assignment button. Start submits an assigned turn. Observe stops without battle inputs; this does not edit individual skills.
mirror_battle_observe: Observe only (debug: stops at the battle)
reward_module_budget_description: Binds to the current cleared run when this task starts. Preserve the saved budget by default; claim only within the cap. Weekly bonuses, Lunacy and conversion stay unchanged.
mirror_shop_policy_description: Boss-adjacent shop visits. Keep your saved rule by default. Manual uses the refresh limit and coin reserve below as written. Learned may only obey those same two settings and the existing gift allow/block list, and falls back to the rule when there are no recorded samples; it is not a trained purchase model. This setting decides no purchase by itself.
mirror_shop_refresh_description: Plain refreshes per shop visit. Pick any number from 0 to 5, or keep your saved value (2 when nothing was ever saved). Nothing here can mean "refresh without limit".
mirror_shop_coin_reserve_description: Coins kept back and never spent in a shop visit. Pick any number from 0 to 500, or keep your saved value (500 when nothing was ever saved). What you pick is used as written, so you can lower it yourself; the learned rule only obeys it and will never lower this floor on its own. A visit that would still carry more than 1500 coins out spends the shelf on what is affordable instead, so the run reaches the floor boss with spent coins rather than a hoard.
launch_emulator_description: Before the device is connected, start the emulator and wait until its ADB address answers. An emulator that is already running is left alone. Leave the program empty to open the emulator yourself. The Open game task then starts the game itself.
launch_emulator_program: Full path of the emulator program
launch_emulator_arguments: Arguments (for example, which instance to start)
